blocks.text: The desktop profile includes editors, Git, Python environments, Go, compilers and common formatters/linters. Optional add-ons provide additional tools. Prefer the project's documented versions, package manager and lockfiles.

This command creates files in .venv in the current directory. Create it only inside an intended project, inspect dependencies before installing them, and avoid changing the system Python environment. Do not use sudo pip.

Check the actual interpreter/tool selected by the project. A tool installed on the host is not necessarily present inside its development environment. Preserve unrelated changes and inspect scripts before running builds, hooks or test discovery.
Builds, package install scripts and test imports can execute arbitrary code. Trust the project and its inputs before execution.

Start with the project’s README and applicable repository instructions. Inspect the current branch, changed files, dependency manifests and selected interpreter. A build or test target can execute code while it is being parsed, so reading a command name is not enough to establish its behavior.

Keep project outputs and credentials in their intended locations. Review a diff before committing and run only the checks permitted by that project. Optional container tooling retains the managed rootless engine’s ownership and storage policy; a project environment does not grant permission to access unrelated data or services.
